title: UK visa and settlement fees increased across most routes
body: Fees for a wide range of UK visa and settlement applications increased for applications made on or after 8 April 2026, including the Standard Visitor visa (reported up from a lower prior fee to £135 for 6 months) and Indefinite Leave to Remain (reported up to £3,226 per applicant). The increase applies across most routes on this site's UK coverage, not a single category; anyone budgeting from an older published figure, a previous application, or third-party guidance written before this date should check the current fee directly rather than relying on a figure that may now be out of date.
